p1_findings.title: GET /api/search not registered — DependencyPicker search is broken
p1_findings.failure_scenario: User opens DependencyPicker and types a search query. GET /api/search?q=auth returns HTTP 404. Typeahead shows no results. Dependencies cannot be discovered or added.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add searchRouter in Source/Backend/src/routes/ and mount it: app.use('/api/search', searchRouter) in app.ts. Contract defined in search.test.ts.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to 69 Specification FRs
p1_findings.failure_scenario: tools/traceability-enforcer.py reports TRACEABILITY PASSED (13/13). 69 Specification FRs (FR-001..FR-069) have zero source coverage — CI gate gives false confidence.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan Specifications/ for FR IDs; verify source coverage. Add Plans/*/requirements-crossref.md mapping Plan FRs to Spec FRs.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Both root-level and pages/ test files run in CI. Duplicate coverage causes false redundancy and merge conflicts.
p2_findings.recommendation: Delete Source/Frontend/tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx and tests/WorkItemListPage.test.tsx (root-level); retain pages/ versions.

p2_findings.title: eslint-disable without justification in production hooks
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Undocumented react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppression can mask stale-closure bugs. Architecture requires justification for every disabled lint rule.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining why the dep is intentionally omitted.

p2_findings.title: 15 High-severity CVEs across Backend and Frontend packages
p2_findings.recommendation: Run: npm update express body-parser browserslist form-data js-yaml nanoid postcss vite source-map-js (Frontend+Backend). npm update path-to-regexp @grpc/grpc-js (Orchestrator).

p3_findings.title: Logger abstraction split across two modules
p3_findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one canonical logger module; remove the other.

p3_findings.title: 14 Moderate-severity CVEs (file disclosure, injection bypasses, misc)
p3_findings.recommendation: Run full npm audit --depth=20 after all immediate and high fixes are applied.

p4_findings.title: 2 Low-severity CVEs (error leakage, low-impact DoS)
p4_findings.recommendation: Address in next quarterly dependency update sweep.
